technology_name: Liquid Jaggery Processing Without Any Chemical Additives
institution: ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute Research Centre, Kannur
problem_solved: Liquid Jaggery Processing Without Any Chemical Additives
description: This process enables the production of liquid jaggery without the use of chemical additives such as clarificants, colouring agents, or preservatives. The method incorporates suitable heating and separation techniques to remove dissolved impurities and obtain a healthier sweetener. The product can be used directly as a natural sweetener and also serves as a raw material for confectionery products and Ayurvedic preparations.
applications:
Jaggery production and sugarcane processing enterprises
Natural sweetener and food ingredient manufacturers
Confectionery and traditional food product companies
Ayurvedic, herbal, and nutraceutical product manufacturers
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agro-processing startups
